birthday-maya-3m9dj.message:
Happy birthday, Maya!

I threw you a party you can carry in your pocket: a cake that never melts, a claw machine full of reasons and a jar of wishes for the year ahead.

Thank you for another year of humming in the kitchen and beating me at board games. Blow out the candles slowly. Whatever you wish for, I'll be right there helping it come true.
birthday-maya-3m9dj.whatILove:
Your laugh at your own puns.
How you hum while you cook.
Your victory dance at board games.
How you hold my hand on the ferry.
That every Tuesday feels like an occasion with you.
birthday-maya-3m9dj.story:
On your first birthday with me, I baked a cake that sank in the middle. You put one candle in the crater and called it a lake.

We've had better cakes since. None of them were as funny.
birthday-maya-3m9dj.dreams:
A birthday under the northern lights.
Summer weekends on the San Juan Islands.
A cake that doesn't sink.
Real tomatoes on our balcony.
